risks.title: ABI compatibility churn
risks.mitigation_goal: Detect ABI breakage before runtime load failures escape to release gates.
risks.signal: No unexpected ABI validation regressions and deterministic guard codes for negative cases.

risks.title: Stream metadata overhead
risks.mitigation_goal: Keep stream control-plane/telemetry overhead within predictable bounds.
risks.signal: Envelope size/serialization latency remains within threshold bands versus baseline.

risks.title: SD I/O latency spikes
risks.mitigation_goal: Detect sustained SD latency regressions impacting upload/catalog flows.
risks.signal: P95/P99 operation latency stays below configured ms limits for key endpoints.

risks.title: Dead-link resilience regression
risks.mitigation_goal: Preserve deterministic dead-link handling and retry semantics.
risks.signal: Dead-link state transitions and retry counters remain deterministic across runs.

risks.title: Trace pressure / telemetry saturation
risks.mitigation_goal: Detect pressure-induced drops or throttle instability in telemetry paths.
risks.signal: Backpressure queue and drop counters remain below sustained-alert thresholds.

risks.title: Save-state compatibility drift
risks.mitigation_goal: Detect compatibility drift in save/restore validation flows.
risks.signal: Restore compatibility validations pass for supported profiles; deterministic reject codes for incompatible payloads.

risks.title: Debug-mode perturbation
risks.mitigation_goal: Ensure debug clock/single-step paths do not destabilize runtime invariants.
risks.signal: Clock mode transitions, step counters, and guard mappings remain deterministic.
